trigger.reason: The prior G1 execution returned a canonical JSON object but could not pass the local subject output validator. Its schema required subject_bundle_sha256, while the old runner did not supply that literal value to the model. This replacement keeps the frozen source evidence, candidate membership, proposal labels, adapter, model, non-thinking mode, and stop behavior constant, and adds only the deterministic identity envelope required by the output contract.

output.provenance: derived from one source-evidence lifecycle-review decision set for a frozen subject bundle
output.permitted_loss: The reviewer receives no retrieval observations, association/provenance results, structural focus output, policy shadow, comparison, report, or previous adjudication ledger. Raw provider response and provider error text are not retained.
output.failure_behavior: Each subject has one attempt. Any provider failure, missing model identity, malformed/incomplete output, challenge, or interrupted attempt leaves the reference proposed; no semantic FI/FE comparison or production conclusion is permitted.

known_reasoning_dependencies: The reviewer shares the DeepSeek provider with the deepseek-v4-flash proposer.
It shares the deepseek-v4-pro model identifier with the earlier source-evidence adjudicator, while using a fresh execution and a separately authored subject verifier prompt.
This establishes procedural separation, not independent error modes or semantic correctness.

partition_contract.aggregation: mechanical only; all nine subject outputs must accept all assigned candidates before the separate reference verification transition.

runner.contract: The runner derives one subject bundle from only frozen inputs, supplies the deterministic batch/subject/candidate/bundle identity envelope required by the output schema, persists a safe started attempt before the provider call, requires a provider-reported model identity, validates exact subject decision coverage, and retains no raw provider response or error text.

stop_condition: Execute subjects in the frozen listed order. Stop after the first non-successful or challenged subject result. Do not retry an executed subject, aggregate partial results, verify the reference, compare semantic FI/FE, or infer a production policy from partial evidence.
authority_boundary: These calls are source-evidence lifecycle review only. They cannot modify the candidate universe, retrieval, association, admission, assessment, report, or production code.
